$comment: Story 4.3, the hill base (ADR-152): Deepa's medicine run — the long walk north to Hebbal General; it lands in Ward 4 at 12:30.

panels.title: AMBEDKAR NAGAR · 07:40
panels.text: Deepa's way: the service road, never the flyover.

panels.title: HEBBAL FLYOVER · 11:50
panels.text: Cars stopped where they were, doors open. You don't look inside.

panels.title: HEBBAL GENERAL · 12:30
panels.text: Ward 4. Your bed, stripped. The isolation doors open. Two of them by the glass, very still.
